review.body:
<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — A RangeError names the sample rate and the first off-grid knot, found in time order. A new test covers 12.5 Hz with the default timings.
- A2: met — The new test derives the extremes from rec.raw and compares them to expectedA100 and expectedMidline within 1e-9. It uses local maxima rather than the literal highest 3 samples.
- A3: unverified — The diff leaves existing tests alone, and the new tests are in a new file. The diff does not show lint, typecheck or test results. It also does not show whether any existing synth.test.ts test calls generateCalibration at an off-grid rate, which would now throw.

<details><summary>2 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- A2 test picks local maxima, not the highest 3 raw samples `src/lib/analysis/synth-calibration.test.ts` — Leave it, or sort rec.raw directly and take the top and bottom CALIBRATION_EXTREMES_COUNT samples if A2 is meant literally.
- Constant imported from ./synth rather than config.ts `src/lib/analysis/synth-calibration.test.ts:2` — Import CALIBRATION_EXTREMES_COUNT from ./config if it lives there.

</details>

_claude-sonnet-5-5 · 1 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._

suggestions.title: A2 test picks local maxima, not the highest 3 raw samples
suggestions.detail: A2 says the highest 3 and lowest 3 raw samples. The test takes the top 3 local maxima and minima instead. This matches the implementation's per-peak definition, but it is not what A2 literally says. At 20 Hz the result is the same, because the sample next to a peak is never higher than another peak.
suggestions.repro: Not applicable; the test passes either way at the default timings.
suggestions.fix: Leave it, or sort rec.raw directly and take the top and bottom CALIBRATION_EXTREMES_COUNT samples if A2 is meant literally.

suggestions.title: Constant imported from ./synth rather than config.ts
suggestions.detail: The constraint says Appendix constants come from src/lib/analysis/config.ts. If CALIBRATION_EXTREMES_COUNT is defined there, the test should import it from there. I can't see where it is defined from this diff.
suggestions.fix: Import CALIBRATION_EXTREMES_COUNT from ./config if it lives there.
